snippet_primary: "App Store fee (iOS purchases) – If a member makes a purchase through Apple's in-app purchase system within the Patreon iOS app, Apple takes a 30% service fee. This fee replaces Patreon's standard payment processing fee for that transaction"
subject_exact: Patreon Creator Fees FAQ states Apple charges a 30% service fee on iOS in-app purchases via the Patreon iOS app; this fee replaces Patreon's standard payment processing fee
metric_unit: % App Store fee (iOS in-app purchases via Patreon iOS app; replaces Patreon processing fee)
local_qualifiers: iOS in-app purchases via Patreon app: Apple 30% service fee applies
Apple fee replaces Patreon's standard payment processing fee (not in addition to it)
Patreon platform fee still applies separately
parser_notes: Patreon Creator Fees FAQ (updated August 5, 2025). iOS in-app purchase fee structure: Apple 30% replaces Patreon processing fee; Patreon platform fee (10% standard) still charged on top. Net creator take significantly lower on iOS purchases.
